final_logic.RED: Nominal predicted crossing at or before the assumed response-time threshold; or already at/inside boundary with unavailable TTE.
final_logic.YELLOW: Nominal crossing after the response-time threshold, or 90% conformal uncertainty intersects the same virtual geofence for 2 consecutive available forecast windows.
final_logic.GREEN: Neither RED nor YELLOW condition is met.

evaluation_unit: individual virtual-geofence scenario, not OR-union across six scenarios
selection_note: N=2 was selected post hoc on BIRDSAI using the frozen Step-7G exploratory criterion. WildBox was not used to select N.
confirmatory_requirement: Apply this rule unchanged to a genuinely untouched confirmatory dataset before final operational claims.
nonclaims: N=2 is not converted to seconds because exact window stride has not been verified.
Response-time thresholds are sensitivity-analysis assumptions, not measured field response times.
The virtual geofence is normalized and is not a real village/farm boundary.
BIRDSAI and WildBox results are retrospective development/transfer evidence.
